_doc: UltraEdge self-build compatibility matrix (ADR-0049). One row per published firmware source tag on the public fork. The EdgeTX base is FIXED by the UltraEdge version: the overlay patches apply only onto the base they were authored against (docs/analysis/SELF-BUILD-FIRMWARE.md §2). Add a row when a tag is published; never edit a published row except 'status', 'exclude' and 'warn'. 'status': current (offered in the forms), pending (builds locally, not offered until its tag is public), retired. Which radios are VERIFIED is not kept here: it comes from docs/release-collateral/SUPPORTED-RADIOS.md at staging (a row with 'verified_section' uses only the SUPPORTED-RADIOS section whose heading contains that text). 'image' = the EdgeTX build container for that base (default ghcr.io/edgetx/edgetx-dev:latest). 'edgetx.version_tag' (only on a stable EdgeTX base) = EDGETX_VERSION_TAG, so EdgeTX's own version string reads it instead of 'pre-<x.y.z>-selfbuild'. 'exclude' = known not to build (reason shown); 'warn' = expected trouble, offered anyway; the release-build workflow's first run on a tag confirms or clears both.

exclude.nb4p: its bootloader needs the s39 build-order fix, which is in the beta only
